title: Freeze gf2-algebra public API surface for verification
description:
Lock the `gf2-algebra` public API surface against changes by recording an explicit api-freeze checkpoint, gating the W6 Lean verification work on a stable signature set.

## Background

W6 verification (V1, V2, V3) consumes the Charon/Aeneas pipeline against the `gf2-algebra` public surface. Per the verification-work conventions in CLAUDE.md, proof code is brittle to API drift — a Charon regeneration after a signature change can invalidate hours of Lean proof work. This issue records an explicit freeze: the public API of `gf2-algebra::packed::*`, `gf2-algebra::permanent::*`, and the dispatch surface in `gf2-algebra::gpu` (where applicable) is locked against breaking changes for the duration of W6.

This is not a code-changing issue. It produces a written sign-off doc that lists the locked symbols, references the W6 Lean issues that consume them, and establishes the change-control protocol (subsequent breaking changes require explicit user approval and re-verification of impacted V1/V2 proofs).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `dev/plans/gf_api_freeze_w6.md` exists and is attached via `jit doc add`, listing every public symbol locked under the freeze.
- [ ] [hard] The doc names the W1-W5 issues (T13, T15, T18, T20, T26) whose surfaces become frozen.
- [ ] [hard] The doc establishes a change-control rule: post-freeze breaking changes require explicit user approval AND a corresponding update to V1/V2/V3 if they consume the changed symbol.
- [ ] [hard] User has signed off on the freeze checkpoint (recorded as an `## Approval` section in the doc and in this issue's description).
